024
025public class HistorianBarEvent extends BaseBarEvent {
026        
027        public static enum OptionId {
028                GREETING,
029                GREETNG_CONTINUE_1,
030                GREETNG_ALREADY_INTRODUCED,
031                GREETNG_PLOG,
032                WHAT_DO_YOU_HAVE,
033                BACKSTORY_BIT,
034                RETIREMENT,
035                END_CONVERSATION,
036        }
037        
038        public static int MIN_SNAPSHOTS_TO_SHOW_PLOG = 12 * 5;
039        
040        public static float PROB_TO_SHOW = 0.5f;
041        
042        
043        protected long seed;
044        protected MarketAPI market = null;
045        protected boolean mentionedRetirement = false;
046        
047        protected transient Random random;
048        protected transient List<HistorianOffer> offers = null;
049        //protected transient HistorianBackstoryInfo backstory = null;
050        
051        public HistorianBarEvent() {
052                super();
053                seed = Misc.random.nextLong();
054        }
055        
056        public boolean shouldShowAtMarket(MarketAPI market) {
057                regen(market);
058                if (random.nextFloat() > PROB_TO_SHOW) return false;
059                return super.shouldShowAtMarket(market);
060        }
061
062        
063        protected void regen(MarketAPI market) {
064                //if (this.market == market) return;
065                this.market = market;
066                done = false;
067                
068                random = new Random(seed + market.getId().hashCode());
069//              offers = HistorianData.getInstance().getOffers(random, dialog);
070        }
071        
072        @Override
073        public void addPromptAndOption(InteractionDialogAPI dialog, Map<String, MemoryAPI> memoryMap) {
074                super.addPromptAndOption(dialog, memoryMap);
075                
076                regen(dialog.getInteractionTarget().getMarket());
077                
078                TextPanelAPI text = dialog.getTextPanel();
079                text.addPara(getPrompt());
080                
081                dialog.getOptionPanel().addOption(getOptionText(), this);
082                //dialog.setOptionColor(this, Misc.getStoryOptionColor());
083                
084        }
085
086        protected String getOptionText() {
087                HistorianData hd = HistorianData.getInstance();
088                return "Go over to the " + hd.getManOrWoman() + " with the paper book and see what " + hd.getHeOrShe() + " wants";
089        }
090
091        protected String getPrompt() {
092                HistorianData hd = HistorianData.getInstance();
093                return "An old " + hd.getManOrWoman() + " sits alone at a table, " +
094                                "leafing through what looks like a genuine hardcopy paper book. As you walk by, " +
095                                hd.getHeOrShe() + " looks up and offers the seat across from " + hd.getHimOrHer() + ".";
096        }
097
098        @Override
099        public void init(InteractionDialogAPI dialog, Map<String, MemoryAPI> memoryMap) {
100                super.init(dialog, memoryMap);
101                
102                HistorianData hd = HistorianData.getInstance();
103                
104                dialog.getVisualPanel().showPersonInfo(hd.getPerson(), true, true);
105                
106                // oh the hacks
107                if (dialog.getInteractionTarget() != null && hd.getPerson() != null) {
108                        this.memoryMap = new LinkedHashMap<String, MemoryAPI>(memoryMap);
109                        memoryMap = this.memoryMap;
110                        
111                        dialog.getInteractionTarget().setActivePerson(hd.getPerson());
112                        MemoryAPI memory = hd.getPerson().getMemory();
113                        memoryMap.put(MemKeys.LOCAL, memory);
114                        memoryMap.put(MemKeys.PERSON_FACTION, hd.getPerson().getFaction().getMemory());
115                        memoryMap.put(MemKeys.ENTITY, dialog.getInteractionTarget().getMemory());
116                }
117                
118                if (!hd.isIntroduced()) {
119                        optionSelected(null, OptionId.GREETING);
120                } else {
121                        boolean hasLog = Global.getSector().getIntelManager().hasIntelOfClass(PLIntel.class);
122                        boolean shouldShow = PlaythroughLog.getInstance().getData().size() >= MIN_SNAPSHOTS_TO_SHOW_PLOG;
123                        //shouldShow = true;
124                        if (!hasLog && shouldShow) {
125                                optionSelected(null, OptionId.GREETNG_PLOG);
126                        } else {
127                                optionSelected(null, OptionId.GREETNG_ALREADY_INTRODUCED);
128                        }
129                }
130                
131        }
132        
133        protected transient HistorianOffer currentOffer = null;
134
135        @Override
136        public void optionSelected(String optionText, Object optionData) {
137                HistorianData hd = HistorianData.getInstance();
138                
139                if (optionData == OptionId.GREETNG_PLOG) {
140                        text.addPara("\"Welcome! I've got something here that I think you'll find very interesting. Your actions over " +
141                                        "the past several cycles have caused quite a stir in certain corners, and I took it upon myself to " +
142                                        "look into your history, as it were. Here, let me transfer the synopsis.\"");
143                        text.addPara("Your TriPad chimes softly; a new program is ready to be installed.");
144                        PLIntel intel = new PLIntel();
145                        Global.getSector().getIntelManager().addIntel(intel, false, dialog.getTextPanel());
146                        options.clearOptions();
147                        options.addOption("\"Thank you! This is fascinating and not at all alarming. Now, what do you have for me?\"", OptionId.WHAT_DO_YOU_HAVE);
148                        return;
149                }
150                
151//              if (optionData == OptionId.GREETNG_PLOG_CONTINUE) {
152//                      PLIntel intel = new PLIntel();
153//                      Global.getSector().getIntelManager().addIntel(intel, false, dialog.getTextPanel());
154//                      options.clearOptions();
155//                      options.addOption("Continue", OptionId.WHAT_DO_YOU_HAVE);
156//                      return;
157//              }
158                
159                if (optionData == OptionId.GREETING) {
160                        text.addPara("\"Welcome, welcome, please sit! I'm sure you're wondering why I called you over.\"\n\n" +
161                                        hd.getUCHeOrShe() + " leans in, as if conspiring, \"" +
162                                                 "I think we can help each other, you and I. See, I have the information,\" " +
163                                                        hd.getHeOrShe() + " taps the book, "+"\"And you have the means.\"");
164                        text.addPara("\"I am what you might call a historian-adventurer; a rogue archaelogist uncovering the " +
165                                                 "history of the Sector despite the danger of this exceptional era. In the course of my "
166                                                 + "studies I often chance upon hints about where certain " +
167                                                 "pieces of technology might be found. Retrieving those artifacts " +
168                                                 "is, naturally, your role in our arrangement. ... Only if you're interested,"
169                                                 + " of course - but I've done my research " +
170                                                 "on your exploits and I'm sure that you will be interested.\"\n\nSpeech complete, " + hd.getHeOrShe() +
171                                                 " leans back, looking pleased.");
172                        
173                        options.clearOptions();
174                        options.addOption("\"I expect you'll be wanting to get paid for this information?\"", OptionId.GREETNG_CONTINUE_1);
175                        return;
176                }
177                
178                if (optionData == OptionId.GREETNG_CONTINUE_1) {
179                        text.addPara("A weary expression passes over the " + hd.getManOrWoman() + "'s face for just a moment before " + hd.getHeOrShe() + 
180                                                 " resumes an energetic demeanor.");
181                        text.addPara("\"I understand why you would assume that; this is a mercenary age. " + 
182                                                "But no, nothing quite so transactional. " +
183                                                 "History is an uncertain trade, and such an approach " +
184                                                 "would lead to expectations, disappointment, and recrimination. All of which I'm eager to avoid, " +
185                                                 "especially the last.\" An additional wrinkle forms on " + hd.getHisOrHer()+ " face at this.");
186                        text.addPara("\"However, if you did find my information valuable, I would gladly accept... donations. Think of it as patronage to " +
187                                                 "fuel my research, which in turn could produce valuable leads. Or it " +
188                                                 "might help to think of it as an investment, but with no obligations incurred " +
189                                                 "by either party. Consider it- you could enrich your own enterprises while contributing to" + 
190                                                 " the sum of human knowledge!\"");
191                        hd.setIntroduced(true);
192                        hd.setRecentlyDonated(); // don't show the donate option first time around
193                        
194                        options.clearOptions();
195                        options.addOption("\"Do you have anything for me now?\"", OptionId.WHAT_DO_YOU_HAVE);
196                        return;
197                }
198                
199                if (optionData == OptionId.GREETNG_ALREADY_INTRODUCED) {
200                        text.addPara("\"So good to see you again, " + Global.getSector().getPlayerPerson().getNameString() + "!\"");
201                        text.addPara("You spend a couple minutes sharing drinks and conversing about " +
202                                        "recent goings-on in the Sector. Before long you get down to business.");
203                        optionSelected(null, OptionId.WHAT_DO_YOU_HAVE);
204                        return;
205                }
206                
207                if (optionData == OptionId.WHAT_DO_YOU_HAVE) {
208                        text.addPara("The historian tells you about...");
209                        
210                        if (offers == null) {
211                                if (random == null) {
212                                        random = new Random(seed + market.getId().hashCode());
213                                }
214                                offers = HistorianData.getInstance().getOffers(random, dialog);
215                        }
216                        
217//                      if (backstory == null) {
218//                              backstory = HistorianData.getInstance().pickBackstoryBit(random);
219//                      }
220                        
221                        options.clearOptions();
222                        if (offers != null) {
223                                for (HistorianOffer offer : offers) {
224                                        offer.addPromptAndOption(dialog);
225                                }
226                        }
227                        
228                        //options.addOption("... an interesting bit of Sector history, but nothing that's immediately actionable", OptionId.END_CONVERSATION);
229                        options.addOption("... something interesting, but not of immediate import", OptionId.BACKSTORY_BIT);
230                        if (!mentionedRetirement) {// && RetirementScript.isEnabled()) {
231                                if (PirateBaseManager.getStandardTimeFactor() >= 1f || Global.getSettings().isDevMode()) {
232                                        options.addOption("\"I've been thinking about retiring...\"", OptionId.RETIREMENT);
233                                }
234                        }
235                        return;
236                }
237                
238                if (optionData == OptionId.RETIREMENT) {
239                        mentionedRetirement = true;
240                        text.addPara("The historian deliberately closes the paper book and brings " + hd.getHisOrHer() + " hands together.\n\n"
241                                        + "\"Are you? It is a big step. Not quite the end of your story, but your life will become... different. You may find time to "
242                                        + "pursue old interests you never quite found the time for... not so unlike myself in this,\" " + hd.getHeOrShe() + 
243                                        " waves a hand around, \"Situation. If you'll allow me to be so brave as to make the comparison.\"\n\n"
244                                        + "\"I recommend you think about what you might do, where you might go.\"\n\n" + hd.getUCHeOrShe() + " smiles. \"You have time, after all.\"");
245                        if (RetirementScript.get() != null) {
246                                RetirementScript.get().showAfterDelay(0.5f + 0.5f * random.nextFloat());
247                        }
248                        options.setEnabled(OptionId.RETIREMENT, false);
249                        return;
250                }
251                
252                boolean forceEnd = false;
253                if (optionData == OptionId.BACKSTORY_BIT) {
254//                      if (backstory == null) {
255//                              forceEnd = true;
256//                      } else {
257                                Random currRandom = Misc.getRandom(seed, 11);
258                                Global.getSector().getRules().setRandomForNextRulePick(currRandom);
259                                boolean shown = FireBest.fire(null, dialog, memoryMap, "HistorianBackstoryBlurb");
260                                if (!shown) {
261                                        SharedData.getData().getUniqueEncounterData().historianBlurbsShown.clear();
262                                        currRandom = Misc.getRandom(seed, 11);
263                                        Global.getSector().getRules().setRandomForNextRulePick(currRandom);
264                                        shown = FireBest.fire(null, dialog, memoryMap, "HistorianBackstoryBlurb");
265                                }
266//                              if (!shown) {
267//                                      HistorianData.getInstance().getShownBackstory().add(backstory.getId());
268//                                      text.addPara(backstory.getText());
269//                              }
270                                options.clearOptions();
271                                options.addOption("End the conversation", OptionId.END_CONVERSATION);
272//                      }
273                }
274                
275                
276                if (optionData == OptionId.END_CONVERSATION || forceEnd) {
277                        text.addPara("You thank " + hd.getHimOrHer() + " for the  information and get up to leave.");
278                        text.addPara("\"See you again soon, somewhere!\" " + hd.getHeOrShe() + " says. \"In my line of work, even I don't " +
279                                                 "know for sure where I'll end up in a couple of months.\"");
280                        done = true;
281                        
282                        if (dialog.getInteractionTarget() != null) {
283                                dialog.getInteractionTarget().setActivePerson(null);
284                        }
285                        
286                        return;
287                }
288
289                boolean initedOffer = false;
290                if (optionData instanceof HistorianOffer) {
291                        currentOffer = (HistorianOffer) optionData;
292                        currentOffer.init(dialog);
293                        initedOffer = true;
294                        //return;
295                }
296                
297                if (currentOffer != null) {
298                        if (!initedOffer) {
299                                currentOffer.optionSelected(optionText, optionData);
300                        }
301                        if (currentOffer.isInteractionFinished()) {
302                                if (currentOffer.shouldRemoveOffer()) {
303                                        offers.remove(currentOffer);
304                                        BarEventManager.getInstance().notifyWasInteractedWith(this);
305                                }
306                                
307                                currentOffer.notifyAccepted();
308                                
309                                if (currentOffer.shouldEndConversationOnReturning()) {
310                                        currentOffer = null;
311                                        optionSelected(null, OptionId.END_CONVERSATION);
312                                } else {
313                                        currentOffer = null;
314                                        optionSelected(null, OptionId.WHAT_DO_YOU_HAVE);
315                                }
316                        }
317                }
318        }
